### A Prayer Checkup
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/a-prayer-checkup
Passage: 2 Chronicles 7:14
Points:
- Swindoll offers a five-question self-inventory to honestly evaluate the consistency and confidence of one's prayer life.
- Cultivating the discipline of prayer shapes and equips leaders far more than secular management strategies.
- Prayer does not seek to persuade God, who already wants to grant what is best for His people.
- Believers are urged to set aside dedicated quiet time to write structured prayers that look upward, backward, inward, and forward.

### A Healing in the Land
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-november-7-2024.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 7:14
Points:
- God's prescription for national revival begins with His own people humbling themselves and repenting of sin.
- Although first spoken to ancient Israel, the principle of renewal applies to believers in any nation today.
- Followers of Christ are called to act as salt and light by modeling the gospel before a watching world.
- Lasting spiritual restoration touches an entire culture only after starting in the hearts of individual believers.
